ns2:course.label: Formal Software Development Methods
ns2:course.description: Mathematical models, languages, and methods for software specification, development, and verification. Same as ECE 478. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 225; one of CS 374, ECE 374 or MATH 414.
